dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Prey... escaped. No dinner today.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: A most fortunate young lad, you are. One hopes you were not frightened?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: What's your name? Where do you live? Why are you out here, playing in the wilds all alone, despite your tender age? Do you not know what would happen, were you to be accosted by wild beasts?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: My name is Razor. Home... is here.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: So many questions. To answer... hard...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: You are clearly no infant, yet you struggle to speak. I sense a tragic past that few may unravel... *sigh* Truly lamentable.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, we meet again! So this is where your walk took you, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you're here too, Razor! This is Ms. Xianyun, one of our friends from Liyue!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: You know this child?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: We do. Friends.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we've known each other for a really long time!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: I saw this child crouched by a Forest Boar without an attending adult in sight. Monsters were roaming not far away, and the howling of wolves could be heard constantly... Truly a harrowing sight.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: If anything were to happen, one... Ahem, I cannot bear to imagine...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, it sounds like you chased the boar away, then? Feels like there might be a misunderstanding here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Razor must have been in the middle of hunting! He often catches Forest Boars around Wolvendom.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You don't need to worry about him, Xianyun, he's really strong! It'll take way more than that to hurt him. Isn't that right, Razor?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Yes. Claws are very strong, very good at hunting.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: What!? Hunting? Absurd...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: A youth of your years should spend their days growing up without worry, in the care of family. How did this come to be...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Razor was actually raised by a wolfpack, so he's learned to hunt, sleep, and live out in the wild just like them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But don't worry, they absolutely do treat him like family!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Not only must he hunt on his own, but he eats and sleeps in the wild too? That simply will not do... He is still a growing boy...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: ...It is time to commence my return journey. Child, you shall come with me to Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Leaving the rest aside, I shall ensure that you are fed and clothed... You seem quite physically capable, as well, so in time, I shall also teach you how to defend yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: No. Save me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh oh, did Paimon's mouth just make things worse?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}, you're up!

choices.text: Actually, everyone in Mondstadt treats Razor really well.

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Mondstadt, lots of meat. So much, that stomach gets round, full.

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Friends and lupical are there. Very warm, very important to me.

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Teacher said, that place where you feel warm is home.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Teacher... Child, do you mean to say you have a master, then?

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Teacher teaches me to talk. Tiring, difficult, but I am trying.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Oh? So your master also teaches you the art of communication, then?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: ...A teacher is like a parent. I imagine, then, that their intent was to let you hone yourself alone...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: And it is true the more a chick is coddled as they grow, the greater the risk there is that they may not be able to fly on their own once they leave the nest...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: In this, I suspect that all who teach generally share the same concerns. I only hope that you will come to understand your master's intentions, sooner rather than later.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Ahem. I may have been too hasty before. Why, even Ganyu and Shenhe stumbled often in their younger years. There was that one time when—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Public service announcement! Razor's hungry!

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Am I...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah, of course you are! Didn't the Forest Boar get frightened off and all...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Ahem! Not to worry. This is a simple matter to resolve.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Just wait here a moment, and leave the rest to my new and improved supreme cuisine machine. Since we had the fortune to meet here, why not enjoy dinner together, and try some Liyue-style cuisine as well?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Say yes, Razor! That machine thingie makes delicious, top-tier stuff that only adepti get to eat, y'know? ...Er, anyway, it's super, super good!

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: It's called a "supreme cuisine machine"! Is such a name so hard to recall?

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Dinner together. Thank you, I will finish it. If you need help, I will help.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Hehe, you're welcome, child.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Simple yet well-mannered. Your teacher has taught you well indeed...

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: If you'd like, feel free to seek me out in Liyue Harbor. Bring your master along as well. My next-generation cuisine machine should be complete by then as well — there will be many more dishes to try then.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: My lodgings are near Chihu Rock, with a nearby landmark being a miniature red-leaf tree. The fork in the road most easily causes people to lose their way... But if you do get lost, you can ask the Millelith patrolling nearby for help. Did you get all that?

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: Too hard.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, we'll bring Razor along sometime, and we'll follow the smell of good food — that won't lead us astray!

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Ha, the whirring of your mental machinations is audible, Paimon.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: But that is fine. Nothing charms me— I mean, charms Shuyu so much about the mortal realm as a little hustle and bustle. We have an accord, then.

choices.text: Razor himself loves living like this.
